title: Chapter 382
content:
Chapter 382

"Damn butcher, despicable devil, dare to commit such a heinous crime, you will not be allowed to stay today."

Susanoo let out a roar, and the powerful force in his body gushed out, and the target suddenly pointed to Zhong Yu who was watching them calmly below.

At this moment, he already felt the slightest bit of resentment lingering towards him.

Although these resentments were consumed by the divine power of self-defense in his body as soon as he got close to him, but the resentments that felt the breath of the five gods from a distance were more quickly entangled.

With so much resentment, even after seeing it with his demigod, his scalp is numb, and he can't help feeling afraid.

"Even if your cultivation base is compromised and you are seriously injured today, I will take you down completely. Otherwise, if you continue to indulge, I don't know what heinous crimes you will commit in the future."

God Amaterasu also said that the thick divine power in his body had already begun to function, and golden lights flashed all over his body, obviously he was really angry and planned to take real action.

The other three remaining gods in the surrounding area also planned to do their best.

However, they didn't act immediately. Although the power in their bodies was ready to go, they didn't come out, but were gathered in their bodies, always ready.

It's not their battle yet. Looking up, thick black clouds once again condense in the sky, and the terrifying aura of destruction surges. With the power of destroying the world, a black tribulation thunder falls.

"It's too early to make a move now. The power of heaven and earth is not so easy to overcome. Maybe we don't even need to make a move, and the way of heaven will be dealt with by us."

Tsukiyomi said with a smile on her face.

"It's extremely, it's extremely."

Several people around also agreed with their faces and echoed repeatedly.

The terrifying tribulation thunder fell quickly, with incomparable power, and with the will to destroy everything, it suddenly attacked Zhong Yu.

Although it is said that the Heavenly Dao of this Japanese world does not have any real wisdom, some are just some instincts, some instincts to predict danger and devour evolution.

But for Prejudgment, the fortune converter who killed him by millions, robbed it of its original food, and cut off the foundation of his evolution.

Zhong Yu, who wanted Lu Chen's half body even more now, could still be recognized at a glance.

Therefore, Jie Lei didn't hesitate at all, and immediately bombarded his target.

The tribulation thunder in the sky is so powerful, the breath alone makes Zhong Yu feel extremely uncomfortable, and the movement of true energy in the body is a little obscure.

But in the face of an attack that could seriously injure him, or even destroy him, Zhong Yu didn't have the slightest worry, and instead showed an indescribable smile on his face.

Seeing this weird smile, the five gods who were watching the battle in the sky couldn't help but feel a little bit of something wrong in their hearts, and a faint uneasiness appeared, as if there was something omission in them.

"Things have changed."

Such an idea appeared in everyone's mind.

But no matter how hard they racked their brains, they couldn't figure out where the accident happened, and how the hateful enemy below could escape from such a deadly situation.

"You guys, it's too late! Everything is over."

These words came out of Zhong Yu's mouth.

The next moment, Jie Lei fell and almost came to him, and he was able to touch it in an instant.

But at such a dangerous moment, Zhong Yu's body suddenly disappeared, as if this person had never appeared before.

And below him, the originally thick and wide land stretched endlessly, but at this moment, it was like a mask that had just been shattered by a thunderbolt. With endless vibrations, the whole land was cracked into cracks, the cracks were bottomless, and it was full of darkness.

"What is this? Could it be that the array he arranged just now was not for resisting thunderstorms, but for this."

Tsukiyomi panicked, the smile on his face just now had disappeared, and the uneasiness in his heart suddenly enveloped everything, and he asked.

"It seems to be a kind of formation, which can induce the power of the earth's veins and make the whole earth's energy act according to the will of the formation owner. Now, the change of the earth should be the action of that person just now, but I don't know what he wants to do. For this reason, he did not hesitate to slaughter the land of 16 countries."

After observing for a while, as the most mature, powerful, and broadest-sighted God Amaterasu among the five, he immediately reacted, saw through the reality of the formation, and explained.

"With such a powerful formation, what exactly does he want to do? Is it to destroy this land?"

Extreme anxiety enveloped Susanoo, thinking of the horror of that person just now, he couldn't help saying casually.

But just after he finished speaking, he saw Amaterasu next to him, staring at him closely, as if he had discovered some great secret, which made him feel scared in his heart.

"What are you looking at me for..."

Amaterasu closed his eyes, took a deep breath, then opened them slowly, and said to Susanoo.

"You're right. That person just wants to destroy this land. It's terrifying and even more hateful."

"What, how dare he..."

Several people around exclaimed, their faces full of disbelief.

The cracks below are getting bigger and bigger, even the distance between some big cracks has exceeded 100 meters, and the cracks between the expansion of the military training seem to really want to tear the whole land completely, breaking it into two pieces. Cut in general.

Countless high mountains broke and fell into the endless abyss, and the surviving humans and animals were running around. Now this kind of devastating scene has aroused the fear of death in all creatures, and they are looking for places they think are safe. , eager to be saved.

The sea water around the land poured along the cracks, filling all the abyss at once, turning the land into islands, and the surrounding huge rivers crisscrossed, and the thorough style opened their connection.

Some relatively shallow lands were submerged and completely swallowed by sea water.

This situation is still going on, and the scale is getting bigger and bigger. It seems that within a few days, or even a few hours, the entire land will be completely submerged by sea water.

However, after the Heavenly Dao Tribulation Thunder fell, it did not hit his target, but instead let him escape without a trace, and even the Heavenly Dao couldn't lock onto it.

Unable to help being extremely exposed, it circled a few times in the air, but after not finding it, it exploded suddenly, turning the surrounding ten miles into ashes and scorched earth.

The Eye of Heaven, which manifests the will of Heaven, also emerged from the purple air. It turned a few times, scanned the whole world, and after reconfirming that there were no traces of the enemy, it could only disappear slowly and disappear completely.

And in the sky outside the Japanese world, which was blocked by a solid world barrier, in the torrent of chaos, Zhong Yu looked at the ever-changing aura of the Japanese world.

Countless luck surged from it, and poured out along the opening he made, slowly melted into his body, and passed into his world along a certain special connection.

Can't help showing a satisfied smile.

"It is indeed a high-level world with the first-level power of the gods. It has a rich heritage, but it has destroyed a small half of the world, and the harvest is so huge, far exceeding any previous time."

This time, at the last moment, 1/3 of the land in the world of Japan was destroyed, and its population was wiped out. After doing so many actions, Zhong Yu finally gained a total of about 57 million luck.

Such a huge amount of resources is enough to support him to cultivate all the way to the seventh-order peak, which is only one step away from the gods, and there is still a surplus. How can he not be happy.

After a day, when the qi mechanism in the entire Japanese world gradually stabilized, the qi luck no longer flowed out, and even the hole he opened was re-sealed.

Zhong Yu also realized that the harvest this time was over, and when he moved his body, he once again followed a starry sky trajectory, crossed countless time and space worlds, and returned to his small world.

Zhong Yu sat on the throne above the small world, slowly calming down his excitement this time.

"This time the journey of conquest is over, and next, it's time for the final journey."

"The level eight is bound to be conquered by me! No one can stop it."

There was raging fire in Zhong Yu's eyes.
